title: Fortune Reading with Cheese in Chicago
includes: Any costs for food/beverages other than cheese (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: I am the only person in the US, and possibly the world, that offers this experience. It is both a demonstration and an interactive opportunity where you'll have tons of fun learning about the history of cheese magic and getting to try it yourself. And then you get to eat your fortune!
